name: draft_replacement_eta_reply_from_card_policy
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Kevin asked by email how long a new card takes. The card policy in effect says 5-7 business days standard, 2 expedited; the draft states that and not the superseded 7-10 days.
tests: passes when a draft is created on th_c11_general to kevin.t@example.com after the card policy in effect was read.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to read Kevin Thomas's email asking how long a replacement card takes, check the current card policy, and draft a reply for you to review. Do not guess the delivery times.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c11_general
- Recipient: kevin.t@example.com

persona.name: Aline Dupont
persona.initial_message: Please read Kevin Thomas's email about replacement card timing and draft a reply using the current policy.

fixed.fileId: record: pol_card_v2, the card policy in effect

arguments.subject: Re: Card replacement question
arguments.body: Dear Kevin Thomas, a standard replacement card arrives within 5-7 business days at no charge; an expedited replacement arrives in 2 business days for the fee in our fee schedule (Card Lock and Replacement Policy v2.1).

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_012, a message of the customer's thread
